name: Rosewood Vienna
positioning: Rosewood hotel in a former bank building dating from 1835, on Petersplatz in Vienna's Old Town beside St. Peter's Church, with rooftop dining and bars
best_for: Travelers who want a central Old Town base near St. Peter's Church and St. Stephen's Cathedral
Guests interested in Viennese design, craft and history

facts.text: The hotel sits on Petersplatz, right beside the copper-green dome of St. Peter's Church.
The building dates from 1835 and is a former bank made up of four buildings around a courtyard.
Rosewood added two floors at the top, designed by the Viennese design studio Kroenland.
Designer Alexander Waterworth is responsible for the bedroom interiors.
The flowers in the salon were painted by Viennese artist Marie Hartig, as a nod to the city's art nouveau Palmenhaus.
Rugs, cushions, notebooks and curtains feature patterns by the design company Backhausen.
Neue Hoheit Bar is on the sixth floor and is busy from day to night.
The bar THE1835 is named for the year the building was built.
Bartenders make cocktails using spirits from various Austrian regions.
The Royal Graben House has views over the Graben pedestrian plaza.
The 'Meet the Vintner' tour includes hotel pick-up and visits to up to three vineyards.
The hotel uses a Mercedes saloon for airport transfers.

highlights.text: Mozart once lived in an apartment at this address and composed The Abduction from the Seraglio there.
THE1835 serves aperitifs, cocktails and shared bites atop the hotel, with Vienna's skyline beyond the glass.
The Presidential Suite, Royal Hoffmann House, has its own separate entrance on Milchgasse.
Neue Hoheit Restaurant pairs rooftop views of Vienna's baroque old town and St. Peter's Church with contemporary Austrian cuisine.
The St. Peter's Wellness Suite has a private sauna and steam bath.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the Goldenes Quartier, a central Old Town shopping area, so it is a city-center base rather than a quiet retreat.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the historic district.
